notes.title: New Horror - Inside Depth 6 Steam page now live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, I hope you are all doing well.
[/b]
I wanted to let everyone here know that [u][b] Inside Depth 6's Steam page is now LIVE![/b][/u]  After many months of development, I am very happy to say that the game is almost finished and ready to provide you all with some long awaited spooks.

I have learned a lot from Suite 776 and lots of the feedback received. I have taking this feedback very seriously and have applied the following to Depth 6:
- Multiple endings,
- A random variant system (some events will trigger differently for everybody),
- Longer gameplay and a stronger focus on story,
- Significantly more exploration relative to Suite 776,
- More secrets and optional puzzles to take part in,
- and of course, an Easter egg; who doesn't love a little bit of Easter egg love?

[b]So what are my plans once Inside Depth 6 is released?[/b]
Once Inside Depth 6 is fully live, I intend to push out a couple of updates to the game within 1-2 months time. This is to scrub a couple of triggers, add a couple of additional areas to explore and a few additional scares.

Most of my time after launch will be focused on research. Due to Covid, I am focusing full time on Game development and Youtube, so this will allow me to focus on researching areas of game development like advanced AI, animations, and most importantly, for me, it gives me time to finally look into virtual reality (VR). It has been a long-awaited dream of mine to delve into some VR development, so now with all of this extra time to focus on game dev, I can allocate a lot of resources to VR research, And who knows, maybe I will be able to add VR support to Depth 6 and Suite 776 within the next several months.

Another area of importance for me is to research controller support and localization. I know that controller support and a lack of additional languages is a major negative to my titles, so I hope to implement some form of controller support and localization in the future - please bear with me on that! :)

So as always, I wish you all a safe and enjoyable 2021, happy gaming, stay safe, and I look forward to hearing from you all once Depth 6 has been released March 12!

Please feel free to provide some of your thoughts in the comments below :)

[b]Steam page link:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1553320/Inside_Depth_6/

notes.title: Version 2 has been released.
notes.content:
Version 2 of A Girls Fabric Face has been successfully released! and here is what happened!

Patch #2 of Version #2 applied on June 13th 2017.

- Added a new area in the basement to explore.
- Roughly 20% additional paranormal % possibilities and triggers.
- Reduced the volume and pitch of the charging station.
- Added an additional charging station at the bottom basement. (New area)
- Added restrictions and light to the final area of the game to ensure no one goes off track and can better determine what to actually do.
- Increased the battery of the camera.
- Reduced the battery drain rate to ensure the camera stays active much longer.
- Added a few new props here and there.
- Minor bug fixes, optimizations and touch-ups.

**Additional trophies were NOT added to not force any people to have to replay the game just to 100% it again.

Nothing too crazy has been added. Just a few things here and there to explore, and a few new scares here and there! 

** The new area is in the basement**

If you do decide to replay the game, please let me know what you think of the changes!

Happy gaming!

Stan.T

notes.title: Version 2.0, A Girl's Fabric Face
notes.content:
Hello all,

It's definitely been quite some time since I've posted any information on the game, reason being I've decided to take a while off from everything since school vacation has begun since May. It's been a nice month of simply relaxing and catching up on things, but not it is time to begin work again.

I would like to throw in 1 more update to the game that will hopefully address the majority of issues found in the game before I begin my next project which will most likely be a 2D horror platform experience. I've never done a 2D game before, so this will definitely be interesting!

For A Girl's Fabric Face, the main changes I will do are:
- Decrease the pitch and overall volume of the battery charging station.
- Slightly increase the speed of the battery charging station.
- Increase the battery life of the camera.
- Increase the paranormal % increase of a couple occurrences.
- And a few more things here and there I may come across.

As for a few additions, I would like to add to the game:
- A new hidden room.
- A couple new items to interact with.
- Several new paranormal triggers.
- And 1-2 new achievements to be unlocked.

There may be a few more things here and there I would like to add to the game; feel free to let me know in the comments if there is anything else that you think should truly be changed or added to the game.

I am expecting to have the game fully complete and updated in 2-3 weeks’ time. After that, I will begin development on my new project. If you would like to follow my progress, feel free to follow my Facebook page.

https://www.facebook.com/turnvex/

Thank you very much!
and happy gaming!

Kind regards,

Stan.T

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
I present to you all the first patch of the century.

Nothing major has been changed or updated. Only the following has changed:

- Added in controls : "i for inventory" as it was not included.
- minor touch-ups.
- minor bug fixes.

More information soon to come. I have a few things I would like to add/ change with this game. At the moment, school has taken over my life, but I will begin working on this game soon once my load has lightened a bit.

Some things to expect include:

- new triggers.
- additional paranormal % trigger exclusives.
- new achievements.
- new mysteries.

Thank you all very much! and until next time!
